name: 97404 · Eugene, OR
findings: ZIP 97404 (Eugene) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97404 (Eugene) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97404 (Eugene) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
